name: Kei Hysi
headline: Entrepreneurship Program Education Lead |  Design Thinking Educator |  Stanford × TUM × CDTM  | UnternehmerTUM
summary:
I design and lead entrepreneurship courses that help people turn ideas into action.
 
As an Entrepreneurship Program Education Lead, I create and facilitate learning experiences where students and teams build, experiment, and solve real-world problems using human-centered approaches.
 
My work is shaped by international experience across institutions like Stanford University, Technical University of Munich, and Center for Digital Technology and Management, as well as programs at Tsinghua University and Hebrew University of Jerusalem. My research focused on how education builds entrepreneurial and innovative mindsets.
 
Today, I:
 
 Lead and design entrepreneurship and innovation programs 
 Facilitate workshops on Design Thinking, leadership, teamwork, and problem-solving 
 Support students and teams in developing and validating ideas 
 
Previously, I:
 
 Worked in venture clienting, scouting and collaborating with startups 
 Led innovation-related projects in the automotive sector 
 Coached agile teams and supported cross-functional collaboration 
 Built digital marketing initiatives for growth 
 
Outside of work, I write and create:
 
 Author of Copëzat poetry book
 Writer on Medium and curator of a Substack newsletter (200+ readers) 
 Creator of digital products 
 
I’m interested in building and scaling programs at the intersection of entrepreneurship, leadership, technology and real-world impact.

company.description:
At UnternehmerTUM, visions turn into value. Our teams empower innovation enthusiasts to take entrepreneurial action. Together with startups and established companies, we drive tech ventures forward - from first idea to market leadership. 

In collaboration with the Technical University of Munich (TUM) and entrepreneur Susanne Klatten, we’ve been promoting future-forward startups such as Celonis, Konux, Lilium, inveox, and Isar Aerospace since 2002.
